2026-09-10.headline: Free Grapeseed Clubhouse, GTA$1M challenge and Biker bonuses
quickTake: Claim the FREE Grapeseed Clubhouse via Maze Bank Foreclosures by September 16 — no GTA+ required.
Sell GTA$1M worth of products for an extra GTA$1M and the Junk Tracksuit.
2X GTA$ on Street Dealer Sales and Bike Service Missions; Bike Service pays 6X for GTA+ members.
Karin S95 is 70% off on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC Enhanced.

beginnerPath.label: Claim the free Grapeseed Clubhouse through Maze Bank Foreclosures by September 16. The Custom Bike Shop is a separate purchase.
Play Community Mission Series for 3X GTA$ & RP on PS5, Xbox Series X|S or PC Enhanced; use the Community Series marker in Legion Square.
Use the Clubhouse meeting-room contracts for 2X GTA$ & RP. Bike Service Missions require the Custom Bike Shop.
If you already own a producing business, sell GTA$1M worth of products to earn the GTA$1M Weekly Challenge prize and Junk Tracksuit. Keep track in the Interaction Menu.
